51:t_1:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[...Measuring brain waves. Baseline rhythm normal.]

51:t_1:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Ensign $$レド$$ is confirmed awake. Resuscitation successful.]

51:t_1:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Under the emergency protocol, I preserved your vital functions through artificial hibernation.]

51:t_1:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Elapsed time: 266,815 minutes. My systems were also suspended, but I restarted 1,451 minutes ago.]

51:t_1:10.en:
$$レド$$
[The $$時空震動$$ during our battle with the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... I can't believe half a year has passed...]

51:t_1:11.en:
$$レド$$
[We've been asleep all that time...?!]

51:t_1:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The situation requires the pilot's judgment. I therefore initiated your awakening process.]

51:t_1:18.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...So this is the treasure $$ベローズ$$ and $$ガロード$$ salvaged. What... is it, exactly?」

51:t_1:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「If I knew, life'd be easy. I can't look inside. I can't even scratch the shell, let alone peel it off.」

51:t_1:20.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I can't imagine how they put it together.」

51:t_1:21.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Stop being stubborn. Why don't you ask $$ガロード$$ or that $c group to help?」

51:t_1:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shut up, $$ベローズ$$! This treasure's mine. I'm not letting anyone lay a finger on it!」

51:t_1:23.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...As long as you pay me what we agreed, I don't care whether you can use it or not.」

51:t_1:24.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You're the one who told me to bring back anything I could find.」

51:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
[And their language... It's incredibly hard to make out.]

51:t_1:31.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I identify it as a form of ancient language.]

51:t_1:32.en:
$$レド$$
[They're not from the $$人類銀河同盟$$... A tribe of unaffiliated drifters...?]

51:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
[They don't seem to have ever seen a $$マシンキャリバー$$.]

51:t_1:34.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I observe attempts to damage this unit, but they appear to lack the means. I infer that their civilization is extremely primitive.]

51:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
[You woke me so I could assess this situation?]

51:t_1:36.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Insufficient data for analysis. However, I have identified machines from the same series as the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s allied units among this group.]

51:t_1:37.en:
$$レド$$
[$$シリウス#keyword$$...? Or the people who joined us for that last battle?]

51:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
[No... I'll find that out in person. First, tell me our current location.]

51:t_1:39.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Coordinates cannot be determined. Measurement reference points have been lost.]

51:t_1:41.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Hypothesis: after this unit was caught in the attack using a $$時空震動$$...]

51:t_1:42.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I believe it synchronized with normal space at randomly selected coordinates.]

51:t_1:44.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I continued your artificial hibernation while transmitting a distress signal. However, events are developing in a way we cannot ignore.]

51:t_1:45.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Please consider a course of action.]

51:t_1:46.en:
$$レド$$
[Easy for you to say... They look like members of humanity, but I can't decide until I know who they are.]

51:t_1:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[External conditions: gravity, 1 G. Atmosphere: chiefly nitrogen, oxygen and carbon dioxide, in ideal proportions for survival.]

51:t_1:48.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Trace components are also present, but no harmful substances have been detected.]

51:t_1:49.en:
$$レド$$
[Even so, I can't leave the cockpit in this situation.]

51:t_1:50.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The surrounding bulkheads appear extremely weak. Even at my current output, I can destroy them and escape.]

51:t_1:51.en:
$$レド$$
[No. If we move carelessly, we'll hurt the people outside.]

51:t_1:52.en:
$$レド$$
[For now, let them do what they want until they get bored. We'll move once everyone's gone.]

51:t_1:57.en: ～$$ガルガンティア$$Fleet　Fleet Commander's Room～

51:t_1:58.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...I understand your situation.」

51:t_1:59.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「In thanks for saving the people of our fleet, I promise as much assistance as we can provide.」

51:t_1:60.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Thank you, Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$.」

51:t_1:61.en:
$$テッサ$$
「May I ask you a few questions?」

51:t_1:62.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「If they are questions I can answer.」

51:t_1:63.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 we had heard about had no ship-fleet society like this.」

51:t_1:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Were you and this green sea brought here by the 《$$新世時空震動$$》?」

51:t_1:65.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...Unfortunately, I lack the knowledge to give you a satisfactory answer. So I will tell you what I saw.」

51:t_1:66.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...One day, about a year ago, we were caught in a strange storm unlike anything we had experienced.」

51:t_1:67.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「When it passed, we noticed that our surroundings were subtly different from the familiar sights we knew.」

51:t_1:69.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$ガロード$$ has told me the basics of this phenomenon of transference.」

51:t_1:70.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Considering the situation before and after, I believe we and this sea came from another world.」

51:t_1:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So that really was the case...」

51:t_1:72.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「But whatever kind of world this is, our way of life remains the same.」

51:t_1:73.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We come together on this sea, form fleets, and travel with the currents and the wind...」

51:t_1:74.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We simply live with the sea, bring new life into the world, and then die.」

51:t_1:75.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There are continents in this world too. Will you not go ashore?」

51:t_1:76.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We have lived at sea since our ancestors' time. We have no wish to change that now.」

51:t_1:77.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We are the people of the $$残されの海$$... We live with this sea.」

51:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even though the world has changed, you are still bound by something like that...」

51:t_1:79.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Please do not misunderstand. We are content with this life.」

51:t_1:80.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We know that other regions have advanced civilizations, like the one that built $$ガロード$$'s machine.」

51:t_1:81.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Living with our backs turned to them, perhaps we truly are the people of a sea left behind.」

51:t_1:82.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Was the name '$$残されの海$$' not given after you came to this world?」

51:t_1:83.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「That name has been passed down from our ancestors. To us, this sea is the world.」

51:t_1:84.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「And wherever people go, whatever they gain, their essential nature does not change.」

51:t_1:86.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「It is to keep living. Our fleet is simply doing that, too.」

51:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand. ...Please forgive my rude remark.」

51:t_1:88.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I took no offense. People find it hard to accept things different from themselves.」

51:t_1:89.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Perhaps, in keeping our current way of life, we too are simply rejecting anything new.」

51:t_1:90.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...$$ガロード$$ told us that $$サイデリアル$$ has recently been appearing in this $$残されの海$$ as well...」

51:t_1:91.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「They pay us no heed. They only seem interested in the $$クジライカ$$.」

uncertain: 51:t_1:81: Rendered the deliberate left-behind wordplay as a sea left behind, while 77/82/83 retain the proper-name token.
51:t_1:47: Preserved all three listed atmospheric components and source claim of ideal proportions.

51:t_1:37: Existing Sirius token points to Aquarion pilot, but Ledo may mean a Sirius allied faction/colony in this Alliance-machine discussion. Kept exact bare source-name token and neutral wording; orchestrator research requested for possible glossary disambiguation.
coordinator_resolutions: 51:t_1:37: Sirius here is an allied faction, as confirmed by the source context and SRW wiki, not the Aquarion pilot.
